    The Deal History screen (UC11 View Deal History; Task 1.9): every completed deal of the buyer, newest deal date first, with its item title, seller, deal date, deal type and outcome (step 2), and a date range, a category and a seller's name to narrow it down (step 3).

    The listing detail screen (UC8 step 7; Task 1.4): all photos, all the listing's fields, the full description, the seller's name with average rating and reviews, the availability status, and three buttons: the action for the listing type (disabled when the listing is not available), Chat with Seller and Report Listing.
